final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), compared AS (SELECT store_id, payment_total, AVG(payment_total) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_average FROM rental_totals) SELECT store_id, SUM(payment_total) AS payment_total_sum, AVG(payment_total - store_average) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE payment_total > store_average GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
